DOTA 2 - WINTER UPDATE

GENERAL UPDATES

HERO CLASS
Heroes now gain class specific benefits depending on their primary attribute.
Strength heroes now gain +0.4% Slow Resistance per Strength.
Agility heroes now gain +0.07% Movement Speed per Agility.
Intelligence heroes now gain +0.1% Magic Resistance per Intelligence.
Talents have been removed from the game.
Heroes Maximum Level decreased from 30 to 25
ATTRIBUTES
Intelligence no longer provides +0.1% Magic Resistance per value.
ABILITIES
Disable Type is a new ability property, replacing the arbitrary rules regarding Debuff Immunity piercing. Every disable in the game - stun, root, banish, or taunt - is now either a Soft Disable or a Hard Disable.
Soft Disable: These abilities work how previous disables worked; affected by status effect manipulating sources; whether this meant increasing or decreasing the disable duration.
Hard Disable: These abilities have an absolute duration that cannot be increased or decreased; they are unaffected by status effect manipulating sources.
DEBUFF IMMUNITY
Debuff Immunity is now the same mechanic as Debuff Resistance/Status Resistance. It is equal to 100% Debuff Resistance. When an ability is cast on you while you are affected by Debuff Immunity, the ability will still deal damage, but the debuff simply expires without ever affecting you.
No longer provides Magic Resistance, Pure Damage Immunity, and Reflected Damage Immunity.
Abilities can no longer piece Debuff Immunity.
MECHANICS
Hex is now separated into a stronger and a weaker version.
Basic Hex. Transforms a unit into a harmless creature, applying Silence, Mute, and Disarm while active.
Strong Hex. Transforms a unit into a harmless creature, applying Silence, Mute, Disarm, and Break while active.
Root is now separated into a stronger and a weaker version.
Basic Root. Prevents the target from moving, casting mobility abilities, and provides True Sight while active.
Strong Root. Prevents the target from moving, attacking, casting abilities, and provides True Sight while active.
Items in the backpack are no longer visible to enemies.
STRUCTURES
Lotus Pools can now be used to refill an empty Bottle with a Water Rune.
Lotus Pools have been relocated to the center of each respective primary jungle.
Tormentor has been removed from the game.
RUNES
Bounty Runes have been reworked. Each one now provides 50 Gold and Experience to the Hero who picks them up. The gold and experience reward is increased by 10 with each spawn. They no longer spawn at the beginning of the game.
Spawn Rate increased from 4 minutes to 2 minutes
Water Runes no longer spawn by default. They can only be acquired through Lotus Pools.
